root.label: Alysia McMillan attends restricted Capitol news conference

events.label: Alysia McMillan attends restricted Capitol news conference

slots.name: date
slots.sentence: In 2025, Alysia McMillan, then a Republican activist, attended a news conference in the U.S. Capitol hosted by a top Democratic lawmaker and restricted to credentialed media.

slots.name: press credentials status
slots.sentence: Ms. McMillan said in an interview that she had no press credentials but argued that the public should have been allowed entry.
